_metadata.description: Web Console rewrite requirements registry linked to PRD operational targets

requirements.title: Pane-Based Terminal Workspace
requirements.description: Render concurrent terminal panes with two-column desktop and one-column mobile behavior.

validation.notes: Verify responsive breakpoint behavior and simultaneous pane rendering.

requirements.title: Production-Grade Web Terminal Fidelity
requirements.description: Support interactive CLIs with PTY resize, cursor reporting, binary-safe streams, and reconnect-safe input semantics.

validation.notes: Validate binary/text frame handling, resize flow, and cursor reporting behavior.
Exercise Claude Code and Codex interactive flows end-to-end.

requirements.title: Durable Session Continuity
requirements.description: Default expiration policy is never; reconnect restores active session state and output emitted while disconnected.

validation.notes: Confirm never-expire default policy and reconnection continuity semantics.
Validate transcript hydration and replay after reconnect.

requirements.title: Proxy-Correct Networking via api-base
requirements.description: Route all HTTP/WebSocket traffic through shared api-base helpers to preserve parent proxy compatibility.

validation.notes: Assert resolved API and WebSocket URLs follow proxied embedding constraints.

requirements.title: AI Input with Provider Fallback
requirements.description: Generate commands with Ollama primary and OpenRouter fallback under deterministic failover rules.

validation.notes: Validate fallback sequencing, timeout handling, and response normalization.

requirements.title: New Terminal Launcher with Configurable Shortcuts
requirements.description: Provide launcher options for empty shell and configured shortcuts with required default presets.

validation.notes: Verify launcher choice flow and default shortcut entries.

requirements.title: Mobile Terminal Usability Toolbar
requirements.description: Expose floating keyboard toolbar with common terminal keys/chords required for mobile-first terminal use.

validation.notes: Validate key injection mappings and toolbar modes.

requirements.title: Sidebar/Drawer Controls Surface
requirements.description: Provide drawer with workspace/session status, controls, and diagnostics without disrupting terminal operations.

validation.notes: Verify drawer state, control actions, and active terminal continuity.

requirements.title: Session Policy Controls
requirements.description: Support never/preset/custom expiration controls at workspace or session scope with explicit persistence semantics.

validation.notes: Validate policy updates, bounds, and persistence behavior.

requirements.title: Shortcut Profile Management
requirements.description: Load shortcut definitions from configuration and parent/workspace context rather than static UI constants.

validation.notes: Validate profile loading, overrides, and fallback defaults.

requirements.title: AI Provider Policy Controls
requirements.description: Expose configurable provider priority, timeout windows, and fallback ordering with health visibility.

validation.notes: Verify policy parsing and runtime provider selection logic.

requirements.title: Operational Observability Coverage
requirements.description: Emit metrics and structured events for session lifecycle, reconnects, pane changes, and provider failovers.

validation.notes: Cover required metrics families and event emission paths.

requirements.title: Collaborative Session Modes
requirements.description: Introduce optional observer/shared-view terminal collaboration modes for coordinated operations.

requirements.title: Persisted Workspace Presets
requirements.description: Save and restore named pane/shortcut presets for repeated operations.

validation.notes: Preset model and UX contracts pending.
